questions_and_answers.question_text: Give three kinds of things that xiū can be used with.

answers.answer_text: Repairing roads, structures, cars, radios, or shoes; trimming hair or pruning trees; and building reservoirs, railroads, roads, or irrigation ditches.

questions_and_answers.question_text: What meaning does the sentence-final -le add in xiūguo hǎojǐcì le?
What dates are given for the Qín Dynasty?
What is the literal meaning of yìzhí zài xiū?

answers.answer_text: "All along in the process of repair" — it has been being repaired all along.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Which marker combination is illustrated by kànguo liǎngcì le?
Translate into Chinese: He has seen this movie twice.
Write a Chinese sentence using xiū in the sense of "to prune."
Translate into Chinese: From the Qín Dynasty up until now, there have been repairs all along.
Translate into Chinese: I've heard that the Great Wall has been repaired a great many times.
Explain the difference in meaning between xiūguo hǎojǐcì and xiūguo hǎojǐcì le.

articles.text:
2. A: Tīngshuō Wànlǐ Chángchéng xiūguo hǎojǐcì le.
   I've heard that the Great Wall has been repaired a great many times.
   B: Shì, cóng Qíncháo dào xiànzài yìzhí zài xiū.
   Yes, from the Qín Dynasty up until now, there have been repairs all along.

Notes on No. 2

xiū: "to repair" roads, structures, cars, radios, shoes, etc. Also, "to trim" hair, fingernails, or "to prune" trees, shrubbery, etc. Also, "to build, to construct" reservoirs, railroads, roads, irrigation ditches, etc.

xiūguo hǎojǐcì le: "has been repaired a great many times" The -le at the end of the sentence adds on the meaning "so far." Here are other examples of the pattern ...-guo... -le:

Zhèige diànyǐng tā kànguo liǎngcì le, hái bù zhīdào zěnme huí shi.
He has seen this movie twice, and he still doesn't know what it's all about.

Tā kǎoguo liǎngcì le, dōu bù xíng.
He has taken the exam twice, but didn't make it either time.

Qíncháo: "the Qín Dynasty" (221-207 B.C.)

yìzhí zài xiū: Literally, "all-along in-process-of repair," i.e., "it has been being repaired all along."
